_comment: Canonical item registry for the TNDK/DCTS price book.
One key per physical thing. Vendors describe the same part five ways; this file
is what lets two quotations be compared line to line.
Add a key only when a real quotation contains the item. Never invent a part.
'compare_note' warns that lines under this key are NOT strictly like for like -
the comparison script prints it next to the price.
'rate_card' names the matching rate in scripts/margin.py, so a real vendor price
can be checked against what we estimate with (PROCURE, OL-009).

condensing-unit-dorin-au-h300cc.description: Dorin condensing unit AU-H300CC, Aeris anti-corrosive coating

condensing-unit-dorin-au2-h751cs.description: Dorin semi-hermetic unit AU2-H751CS, 7.5 hp / 8.1 kW
condensing-unit-dorin-au2-h751cs.compare_note: Quoted inclusive of TE5 expansion valve, orifice and valve body - a package, not a bare unit.
condensing-unit-dorin-au2-h751cs.rate_card_note: RATES['unit_freezer'] is meant to cover the condensing unit AND the evaporator for one freezer room. The comparison above is against the condensing unit alone. The like-for-like figure is 12,700.00 + 4,350.00 (Gunay evaporator) = 17,050.00 against a 6,400.00 rate - 166% above, not 98%. The rate is also flat per room and does not scale with duty; this quote is for a 41.6 cbm freezer at -25 Te.
condensing-unit-dorin-au2-h751cs.suffix_note: Quoted for the Samoosa freezer room. Suffix and application agree.

evaporator-gunay-gne-245-8c.compare_note: Airtronics quoted this model at three prices in ten weeks: 4,350.00 (28 Jul), 4,300.00 (6 Oct) and 3,950.00 (7 Oct) - the last two one day apart. Ask which stands before ordering.

hinged-door-90x190.description: Hinged cold room door 90 x 190, right opening
hinged-door-90x190.compare_note: Frame count differs between quotations (3 frame vs 4 frame) at the same 1,800.00. Confirm which frame is being priced before treating the rate as settled.
hinged-door-90x190.rate_card_note: Two independent quotations nine days apart both at 1,800.00. The door rate in margin.py is confirmed against live vendor pricing as at 29 August 2026 - the first rate in the card to have a verification date (OL-009).

control-panel-subzero-crc205200.compare_note: Body material and vendor both move the price: Arctic plastic body 950.00 (20 Aug), Airtronics metal body 975.00 (28 Jul), Airtronics plastic body 975.00 (6-7 Oct). Arctic is the cheaper source for the same plastic body.
control-panel-subzero-crc205200.rate_card_note: The rate is ABOVE the real price here, which is the safe direction - it overstates cost, so realised margin on jobs priced with it is better than computed, not worse.

filter-drier-dcl164-half.description: Filter drier 1/2", FLARE type, Danfoss DCL 164
filter-drier-dcl164-half.compare_note: Flare connection. See filter-drier-dcl164s-solder and filter-drier-castel-df308-4s for the solder and Castel alternatives at the same size.

filter-drier-dcl164s-solder.description: Filter drier 1/2", SOLDER type, Danfoss DCL 164S

expansion-valve-te2.description: Thermostatic expansion valve TE2 / TES-2, R404A/R507A

sight-glass-sgi12s.compare_note: Two quotations specify SOLDER type at 65.00; one states no connection type at 90.00. Confirm the 90.00 line's type before treating the 38% gap as a saving.

ball-valve-half.compare_note: Different brands: Danfoss GBC 12S (009L7022) vs Castel 6570/4. Function-equivalent, not identical.

pressure-switch-kp15.description: Dual pressure switch KP15, auto reset
pressure-switch-kp15.compare_note: Bundling differs: 180.00 bare (Airtronics 6 Oct, unnamed 16 Sep), 185.00 with flexible hose (Airtronics 7 Oct), 230.00 switch only (Arctic 16 Sep). Arctic is the outlier on an otherwise settled 180-185 rate.

flare-nut-half.compare_note: Brands differ (Olab vs RW). Commodity fitting.

flare-nut-three-eighths.compare_note: Brands differ (Castel 7010/33 vs RW). Commodity fitting.

flexible-connector-1mtr.description: Flexible connector / charging hose with 1/4" nut, approx 1 m
flexible-connector-1mtr.compare_note: Called FLEXIBLE HOSE RED/BLUE on one document and FLEXIBLE CONNECTOR WITH 1/4 NUT -1MTR on the other. Quantities differ between documents (2 vs 3).

vibration-eliminator-half.compare_note: Brands differ (Harbax vs Castel 7690/4). Harbax has been quoted at 40.00, 50.00 and 60.00 - the 40.00 is the current Airtronics rate.

vibration-eliminator-one-three-eighths.compare_note: Size read as 1-3/8" from the model column of the Airtronics quotation. Medium confidence - confirm before using as a rate.

solenoid-valve-1068-4a6.compare_note: Two suppliers quote 155.00, one of them stating '+ COIL' explicitly. Arctic quotes 175.00 without saying whether the coil is included - confirm. A coil is a separately priced part.

solenoid-valve-1078-4a6.compare_note: 1078 series, NOT the 1068 quoted elsewhere. Do not substitute one for the other on price.

copper-coil-three-eighths-50ft.description: Copper coil / pipe 3/8" x 50 ft roll

pipe-insulation-7-8-x-3-8.compare_note: Lengths differ and drive the price: one supplier quotes a 1.8 m piece, Arctic states no length. Use unit_size to compare per metre, not per piece.

pipe-insulation-7-8-x-3-4.description: Rubber pipe insulation 7/8" bore x 3/4" wall, World Flex
pipe-insulation-7-8-x-3-4.compare_note: 3/4" wall - thicker, and a different product to the 3/8" wall item. Length not stated.

pipe-insulation-5-8-x-3-4.description: Rubber pipe insulation 5/8" bore x 3/4" wall

capillary-tube-bulk.description: Copper capillary tube 0.090", bulk, priced per metre
capillary-tube-bulk.compare_note: Bulk tube off a 100 ft coil, no fitting. NOT the same product as capillary-assembly-with-nut - that one is cut to length with a nut fitted.

capillary-assembly-with-nut.description: Copper capillary, cut length, with 1/4" nut fitted
capillary-assembly-with-nut.compare_note: Lengths differ across quotations (0.9 m / 1.0 m / 1.5 m). Compare per metre using unit_size, never per piece.

charging-union-quarter-npt.description: Charging union / NPT connector, 1/4" flare x 1/8" NPT
charging-union-quarter-npt.compare_note: Castel 7140/21 on one document, an unbranded charging union w/pin on the other.

castel-connector-9150-r02.compare_note: A different part to the 1/4" x 1/8" NPT charging union. Kept separate deliberately - they were conflated in the first comparison and should not be.

vibration-pad.compare_note: Arctic specifies Airtech 18x18x3/8. The other documents state no size.

brazing-rod-45pct.compare_note: Brands differ (Sopor vs Harris) and the pack basis is unclear on both documents ('RED/BLUE', '2PCS'). Confirm what one unit is before comparing 60.00 with 65.00.

condensing-unit-dorin-au-h505cs.suffix_note: Quoted for a freezer room on R404a. Suffix, refrigerant and application all agree.

condensing-unit-dorin-au-h405cs.suffix_note: CONFLICT: the CS suffix says freezer, but Airtronics quotes it for the 76.5 cbm marination CHILLER on R134a. Confirm the model.
condensing-unit-dorin-au-h405cs.compare_note: CONFLICT: the CS suffix says freezer, but Airtronics quotes it for the 76.5 cbm marination CHILLER on R134a. Confirm the model.
